root_cause: The live-released brand learning integration placed 'const editorialSystem' before 'const verifiedBrandLearningGuide', while the editorial expression reads the guide for all non-personal channels. This produces a Temporal Dead Zone ReferenceError when company LinkedIn, blog, or Instagram generation reaches the editorial stage.

observed_evidence.original_expression: pending.channel==='linkedin_company' ? system + verifiedBrandLearningGuide : system + ' ' + STEERING_BRAND_CONTRACT + verifiedBrandLearningGuide

fix: Move construction of verifiedBrandLearningGuide immediately before editorialSystem, after verifiedBrandLearnings has been selected. Preserve existing proven-only tenant-scoped evidence, prompts, authorizations, publication gates and schedule.
prevention_rule: Construct dependent lexical constants before evaluation of any conditional branch referencing them; regression tests enforce declaration/read sequence and customer-source gating. Never report publication or next-day lift from passing source tests alone.
terminal_rule: Required and CodeQL exact head green, protected merge, GitHub-integrated production deployment and subsequent genuine daily content generation + publication/outcome readback separately.
